newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY EASIER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY EASIER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier against most hard currencies at the close of fairly quiet Wednesday interbank trade, dealers said.
"There wasn't much activity in the market today. There were a couple of last-minute buyers but the market wasn't short -- just people trying to cover for small payments," one dealer commented.
The local dollar finished the day at 11.1400/1500 against the U.S. unit, down from Tuesday's 11.1225/1325 and slipped to 18.0010/0250 from 17.9730/18.0000 against pound sterling.
It was also quoted weaker on the rand at 2.5015/5190 compared to 2.4995/5035 but edged up to 6.4920/5000 from 6.5075/5150 against the mark.
